changelog: Startup & Connect Crash Immunity: Thread-safe post_ui dispatch queue eliminating cross-thread Tcl interpreter mutations and ucrtbase.dll 0xc0000409 buffer overrun crashes
Seamless In-App Title Bar (CSD): Stripped external Windows OS title bar, integrated minimize, maximize, and close controls directly into top app tab bar with native dark-mode hover states
Instant Hang-Proof Exit: Multi-stage 0ms window hide, background worker teardown, and clean kernel exit (os._exit) eliminating freeze on close
Silent Automated Testing: Mocked audio hardware streams and system chimes during automated execution
Discord-Grade 48kHz HD Audio: Native studio-quality 48,000 Hz VoIP with zero resampling aliasing distortion and backward compatibility
Discord Voice Suite: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) with decibel threshold slider, Push-to-Talk, and live VU meter
Let's Check Loopback Mic Test: Real-time self-hearing test loop directly from microphone to headphones
Advanced Voice Processing: Echo Cancellation, Noise Suppression (Fan/Hum filter), and Automatic Gain Control (AGC)
Adaptive 60 FPS Fluid Rendering Engine: Sub-millisecond motion resampling during desktop movement with instant stationary HD clarity
Authenticode Signed Binaries: Digitally signed with SHA-256 and DigiCert RFC 3161 timestamps
